answer: An honest proof costs 91 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 701 of them, which totals 63791 POA. This epoch the gate asks one thing only: Toymaker wooden doll warrant counted beside the guild hall, and the receipt must read each wooden doll is a tally of painted faces weighed beside the workshop stamp. The walnut opens the gate, the timber pays the toll, the vertex proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. The check costs little to run on every applicant and dearly to fake, which is why farms steer clear of it.
